title: 第1546章 我依然是最终胜利者第1545章 渡梦救场
content_zh:
“琉璃，让你担心了，我对你的担心也丝毫不少，你太傻了，法则之罚岂又是你能扛住的，力所不及而不为，哪怕是眼前之人是你此生最重要之人，因为他同样希望你不受到伤害”
应无悔真挚地说道。
“嗯，我知道了不识，我不会让你再担心的”
琉璃像犯错的孩子一样略带羞愧地答道。
“琉璃，我成功开创出界外之道，这是八大界颠复性的成果，必然引来无数人的觊觎，即使这件危机解除之后，我们接下来要面对的只会是更危险的事情。
经此一事之后，我深刻认识到自己还没有绝对的实力保护和守护好你，所以琉璃，你不能一直待在我身边，这是我为你的安全考虑，也请宽恕我的自私”
应无悔说道，他一会带着喜悦，又过一会转变为严肃，没有什么比琉璃的命还更重要的事情。
“我理解你，我不能拖你后腿，我要努力变强，强大到足以对你有用。
不识，我们总是见少离多，然大势所趋，我和你都不能够按照自己的意愿活着”
琉璃知道自己太弱小，只会成为应无悔的累赘，况且应无悔身份暴露，上界的天神是不会轻易善罢甘休的，哪怕是大长老成挚承诺，有太多天神是抵抗不住界外之道这种超出八大界所有规则力量的诱惑的，现在的多数天神，只是碍于八位长老，以及太多的天神在场，按耐不发罢了。
琉璃保护不了应无悔，而应无悔若是因为保护琉璃而露出破绽，那岂不是琉璃自己害了他，所以琉璃想好了，待此事结束，回到下界，她要靠自己修炼变强，不能再麻烦应无悔，再向应无悔继续索取。
“琉璃，我相信在不久的将来，我们一定能按照自己的意愿而活，而非是在他人的设计影响下活着。”
“我也相信。”
应无悔没有时间与琉璃继续说些真情流露的话，界外虚空与法则之罚的事情解决，青天世界回归正轨，所有天神对他虎视眈眈。
原先数万名的天神，如今只剩下万人不到，这次事件对八大宗与万界庭内部的结构会造成非常大的冲击，更何况最为重要的万界庭领袖，神主普化死亡，万界庭之后的所有决策，又得重新回归到各大高层之间的商议，而非由神主直接拍定，万界庭内部班子人员，会重新洗牌一部分，八大宗的核心没有动摇，不过高层与精英同样会有变动。
邀遏道：“应无悔的事就这么放任不管吗，底下有太多反对的天神，大长老”
“我们应允他的事情，绝无二话与反悔之意，让他离开上界，他下界之后会发生什么事我们不管，如果再次来到上界，我可就没有这个保证”
成挚先前与众长老商议定下，这是无法更改的决策，碍于当时情况处境，不得不为之，他成挚放出去的话，没有做不到这一说，他守信与规矩，是不会改变的。
幻想真君道：“这位年轻人掌握了超越世间所有规则的力量，这对于现在的他来说，坏事远大于好事”
陌上桑道：“深藏不露，我从来不注意一个不重要的人，直到这个人突然变成一个重要的角色，推算预演界外虚空爆发，便达到我身体的极限，其余的令我无心预言，真是应了一句话——未来无法完全预料，视线的焦点也可能落在最不起眼的地方”

“呵呵，这小子运气不赖，大事不是由他解决，而成果反倒由他收获，令人羡慕的气运。
诸位长老，这重大的事情解决，我也要重新出去远游了，我的剑技还是不够，帮不了大忙，那位昭光，不管是在剑技与对剑意的理解上面都远超过我，不过此战过后，我有了一丝顿悟，这感觉，令人不赖。
唉呀，很久没有在剑技上有突破的感觉了……”
流水真君一副总算结束，慵懒地伸着腰说道。
既炎铉道：“流水，你九长老的名号是在八大宗定下了”
“什么，你们认真的吗？那我岂不是要和你们一样，教上一大堆没有剑道天分的弟子，浪费我宝贵的时间”
流水真君一想到成为长老之后的种种麻烦事，就一阵无语。
“是名誉长老，怎么，不想要也可以，没有任何人，可以限制你，你一直都是自由的，难道是流水你自己束缚了自己？”
“呼，和你们这群人说话真是累，老是藏着掖着，话永远只讲一半或片面之词让人自己去确定。”
“这位叫应无悔的小孩子的事情先放一放，他怎么样都没有我们自己的事情重要，我们八大宗无论如何都得先把自己内部的事情先解决如——战死成员的后事荣誉，八大超级法器的修复，贡献分的兑换……”
药沁心一下子说出几十条亟待解决的事情。
“解决内部事情优先，而那应无悔，那是我们共同商议的决定，底下的天神我会对他们进行一番心理上的疏导的，以免事情闹大，本来这件大事情刚刚过去，这些天神不为宗门内牺牲掉的英雄们哀悼，反而是一个个的有意无意的惦记起那界外之道”
太岁真君道。
content_en:
"Liu Li, I've made you worry. I'm not worried about you at all. You're too stupid. You can't bear the punishment of the law. You can't do anything if you can't do it. Even if the person in front of you is the most important person in your life, because he also hopes that you won't be harmed."
Ying Wuhui said sincerely.
"Well, I know or don't know, I won't let you worry anymore."
Liuli replied with a little shame like a child who made a mistake.
"Liu Li, I have successfully created a way out of the world. This is a subversive achievement in the eight worlds, and it will inevitably attract the covetousness of countless people. Even after this crisis is resolved, what we will face next will only be more dangerous things.
After this incident, I deeply realized that I don't have the absolute strength to protect you, so Liuli, you can't stay with me all the time. This is for your safety, and please forgive my selfishness."
Ying Wuhui said, he was joyful for a while, and then turned serious for a while. There was nothing more important than Liuli's life.
"I understand you, I can't hold you back, I have to work hard to become strong enough to be useful to you.
I don’t know, we always see less and leave more, but the general trend is that neither you nor I can live according to our own wishes."
Liuli knew that she was too weak and would only become a burden to Ying Wuhui. Moreover, if Ying Wuhui's identity was exposed, the gods in the upper world would not give up easily. Even if the great elder Chengzhi promised, there were too many gods who could not resist the temptation of the outside world, which was beyond all the rules of the eight realms. Most of the gods now could only hold back due to the presence of eight elders and too many gods.
Liuli couldn't protect Ying Wuhui, and if Ying Wuhui exposed his flaws because of protecting Liuli, wouldn't it mean that Liuli himself had harmed him. So Liuli had thought about it. After the matter was over and she returned to the lower world, she would rely on her own cultivation to become stronger. She could no longer trouble Ying Wuhui and continue to ask for more from Ying Wuhui.
"Liu Li, I believe that in the near future, we will be able to live according to our own wishes instead of living under the influence of other people's designs."
"I believe it too."
Ying Wuhui did not have time to continue to speak true words with Liuli. The matter of the void outside the world and the punishment of the law was resolved, the world of Qingtian returned to normal, and all the gods were eyeing him.
There used to be tens of thousands of gods, but now there are less than 10,000 left. This incident will have a huge impact on the internal structure of the eight major sects and the Ten Thousand Realms Court. Not to mention the death of the most important leader of the Ten Thousand Realms Ting, the God Lord. All decisions after the Ten Thousand Realms Ting will have to return to discussions among the top leaders, rather than directly decided by the God Lord. The internal team members of the Ten Thousand Realms Ting will be reshuffled. The core of the eight major sects will not be shaken, but the top management and elites will also change.
Yao Li said: "Are you just going to let things go without regrets? There are too many gods who are against you, Great Elder?"
"We promised him without any hesitation or regret, and let him leave the upper world. We don't care what happens to him after he comes down to the upper world. If he comes to the upper world again, I don't have this guarantee."
Cheng Zhi had previously discussed with the elders and decided that this was a decision that could not be changed. Due to the circumstances at the time, he had to make it. If Cheng Zhi released it, he would not fail to do so. His trustworthiness and rules would not change.
The True Lord of Fantasy said: "This young man has mastered the power that transcends all the rules in the world. For him now, the bad things are far greater than the good things."
Mo Shang Sang said: "Hide it deeply, I never pay attention to an unimportant person, until this person suddenly turns into an important role. It is estimated that when the void breaks out outside the preview, it will reach the limit of my body. The rest makes me unintentionally predict. It really is a sentence - the future cannot be completely predicted, and the focus of sight may fall on the most inconspicuous place."
"Haha, this kid is very lucky. It's not him who can solve the big problems.Instead, he reaped the fruits, an enviable luck.
Elders, after this important matter is resolved, I have to travel again. My sword skills are still not enough to be of much help. That Zhaoguang far surpasses me in terms of sword skills and understanding of sword intentions. However, after this battle, I had a hint of enlightenment. This feeling is not bad.
Alas, it’s been a long time since I felt like I had a breakthrough in swordsmanship..."
Lord Liushui stretched his waist lazily and said as if it was finally over.
Ji Yanxuan said: "Liu Shui, your title of Ninth Elder was decided by the Eight Great Sects."
"What, are you serious? Then I will be like you, teaching a lot of disciples who have no talent in swordsmanship and wasting my precious time."
When True Lord Liushui thought about all the troubles he would face after becoming an elder, he was speechless for a while.
"You are an honorary elder. Why, it's okay if you don't want it. No one can restrict you. You have always been free. Could it be that you, Liu Shui, have restricted yourself? "
"Huh, it's really tiring to talk to you guys. You always hide things, and you always only tell half or one-sided things for yourself to determine. "
"Let's put this kid named Ying Wugui's affairs aside for now. He is not as important as our own affairs. Our eight major sects must resolve our own internal affairs first no matter what, such as the posthumous honors of the members who died in the battle, the repair of the eight super magic weapons, the exchange of contribution points..."
Yao Qinxin listed dozens of things that needed to be resolved urgently.
"Resolving internal matters should be given priority, and there should be no regrets. That is a decision we made together. I will give some psychological guidance to the gods below to prevent the matter from getting bigger. Originally, this big incident has just passed. These gods did not mourn for the heroes who died in the sect. Instead, they all thought about the way outside the world intentionally or unintentionally."
Tai Sui Zhenjun Dao.
